agent: espionage wave, reader E (the AI's spying), 2026-10-14
question: When the intelligence minister acts and for whom, what IntelligenceMinister_Tick in TFH's ai_intelligence_minister.lua does, what each engine method it reaches answers, which Lua argument of CChangeSpyMission and CChangeSpyPriority lands in which field, and what Germany's minister would set on 1 January 1936

addresses.name: CAIEspionageMinister::DoWork
addresses.comment: **Virtual slot 10 - the intelligence minister's daily tick, and the whole of it is the hour gate and one Lua call.** 0x89CEC0 to the bare `ret` at 0x89CF4C; one try block catching luabind::error, whose handler (0x89CF4D) hands the error's state (+0xC) to ReportLuaError (`LUA Error: ...` in the log) and resumes at the epilogue 0x89CF3C. In order: `+0x30 countdown = 1` (so CAIAgent::Update calls it again on the very next pass); then acts only when `(this->country_id (+0x38) + 1) % 24 == (gamestate->tick - 0x29C55C0) % 24`, both signed `idiv` remainders - once a game day, in the hour (id + 1) mod 24; then GetThreadLuaState, Lua_IntelligenceMinister_Tick (0x49D0D0) fetches the global `IntelligenceMinister_Tick`, and LuaCallProxy_IntelligenceMinister_CallVoid (0x49D050) calls it with one argument - this minister, pushed as its most derived class - and no result. **No C++ espionage logic runs here**: no weekly sub-task as the politics minister has, no test of who plays the country or of in_game - those gates are upstream (ProcessAI, CEU3AI::CreateMinisters, CAIAgent::IsEnabled). The engine class is Espionage, the Lua entry point Intelligence. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-espionage.md, section E.
addresses.revises: Adds the try block and its handler, the extent, the two Lua helpers by name, and the negative that nothing else runs; the hour gate and the countdown store are unchanged.
addresses.evidence: Read whole on the listing 0x89CEC0-0x89CF5D: `mov [esi+0x30],1` at 0x89CEEB, `inc eax` on [esi+0x38] then `idiv 0x18` against `[gs+0xBDC]-0x29C55C0` `idiv 0x18` at 0x89CEDF-0x89CF13, calls 0x8EACA0, 0x89D0D0, 0x89D050 and nothing else; ehcatches.py 0x89CEC0 lists one try catching .?AVerror@luabind@@; the funclet at 0x89CF4D calls 0xAA8050 (ReportLuaError) and returns 0x89CF3C. The saves agree with the hour: in Germany1936_04_20_03.hoi3 76 of the 77 AI countries' spy_date stamps all carry the hour (id + 1) mod 24 plus one (the command's Execute stamps it an hour after the post). Wrong if a second call site of slot 10 passed through a different body, or if a funclet past 0x89CF5D belonged to this frame.

addresses.name: CAIEspionageMinister::Enable
addresses.comment: **Slot 52, the intelligence minister's override of CAIAgent::Enable.** 0x89CB30 to the bare `ret` at 0x89CDCA. `+0x3C enabled = 1`; then appends a 0x10-byte listener node `{this, prev = old last, next = 0, byte 0}` to **seven** observer channels of the table at VA 0x1B14DC0 (16 bytes a channel, first/last/count): 0x14 (0x1B14F00), 0x15 (0x1B14F10), 0x19 (0x1B14F50), 0x1A (0x1B14F60), 0x1B (0x1B14F70), 0x1C (0x1B14F80) and 0x17 (0x1B14F30), in that order; then makes the game state if there is none and sets **`+0x30 countdown = MT19937Next(&gamestate->+0x124) % 10 + 1`** - one draw on the AI's generator, so the first DoWork comes 1 to 10 AI passes after the minister is made (the politics minister's is % 3 + 1). **Every handler the channels can reach on this class is empty**: slots 11-47 of CAIEspionageMinister's table are the shared stubs 0x60CD50 (ret 4), 0xA806D0 (ret 8) and 0x84A610 (ret 0x10) - channel 0x15 calls slot 41 on a war joined and 0x14 slot 40 on a war left (BroadcastToListeners2) - so the subscriptions make nothing happen for espionage. Called by CEU3AI::CreateMinisters through [vftable+0xD0] right after the minister is appended to the agent list, and by ApplyPlayerDelegation.
addresses.evidence: Read whole on the listing; vtable.py --holding 0x89CB30 answers CAIEspionageMinister slot 52 alone. The seven `mov esi,[0x1B14Fx4]` / `mov [0x1B14Fx4],eax` / count `inc` triples at 0x89CB52-0x89CD32; the draw at 0x89CDA3 `lea eax,[esi+0x124]; call 0xAA2B90; cdq; mov ecx,0xA; idiv ecx; inc edx; mov [edi+0x30],edx`. The stubs read at 0x60CD50, 0xA806D0, 0x84A610. Wrong if a channel among the seven dispatched to slot 0, 10, 49 or 52-59 (the only non-stub slots), which was not enumerated for 0x17 and 0x19-0x1C.

addresses.name: AIMinister_UnsubscribeAndDisable
addresses.comment: **Slot 49 of the intelligence, foreign and production ministers - one folded body.** For each of the seven observer channels 0x17, 0x14, 0x15, 0x19, 0x1A, 0x1B, 0x1C (VA 0x1B14F30, F00, F10, F50, F60, F70, F80) it walks the list for the node whose target is `this` and clears the target (the broadcasters unlink cleared nodes), then tail-jumps to CAIAgent::DisableAndDisband (0x49C8A0). The undo of the three ministers' Enable subscriptions. Named for no one class (trap 4): three tables hold it.
addresses.evidence: Read whole on the listing 0x89CDD0-0x89CEBA, ending `jmp 0x89C8A0`; vtable.py --holding 0x89CDD0 lists CAIEspionageMinister, CAIForeignMinister and CAIProductionMinister at slot 49 and nothing else; CAIForeignMinister's Enable (0x89D360) appends to the same channel slots 0x1B14F04, F14, F54, F64, F74, F84. Wrong if the third holder were not a minister subscribing to these channels (it is the production minister; its Enable was not read).

addresses.name: LuaCallProxy_IntelligenceMinister_CallVoid
addresses.comment: The void call of `IntelligenceMinister_Tick`. Does nothing if the proxy's called flag (+0x10) is set; else sets it, lua_gettop, pushes the argument through LuaPushArg_IntelligenceMinister (0x49D110), and calls the proxy's +8 (luabind::detail::pcall) with **1 argument, 0 results**; a non-zero status throws luabind::error (ThrowInfo 0x164B21C) - caught by DoWork, which logs it - and the stack is put back with lua_settop. One caller, DoWork at 0x89CF37. The politics minister's twin is 0x4A1FC0.
addresses.evidence: Read whole 0x89D050-0x89D0C9: `cmp byte [esi+0x10],0`, `call [0xD2B4F0]` (gettop), `call 0x89D110`, `push 0; push 1; push edi; call [esi+8]`, `push 0x164B21C ... call 0xB9894B` (throw), `call [0xD2B4F8]` (settop); findRefs --callers 0x89D050 answers 0x89CF37 alone. Wrong if [esi+8] were not pcall - Lua_IntelligenceMinister_Tick stores 0xB7E9D0 there, which FINDINGS-luahost.md names luabind::detail::pcall.

addresses.name: LuaPushArg_IntelligenceMinister
addresses.comment: Pushes the one argument of `IntelligenceMinister_Tick`: nil for a null minister (lua_pushnil), otherwise __RTDynamicCast (0xB97799) to the most derived class and the instance push (0xB7C320 for a registered class, else 0x49D160) - so the script receives a CAIEspionageMinister. One caller, 0x89D073.
addresses.evidence: Read whole 0x89D110-0x89D156: `mov ecx,[eax]; mov esi,[ecx]; test esi,esi`, `call [0xD2B4C4]` (pushnil) on null, `call 0xB97799` with the type descriptors 0x171E09C/0x17147E8, then 0xB7C320 or 0x89D160. findRefs --callers answers 0x89D073 alone. addresses.name: LuaConstruct_CChangeSpyPriority
addresses.signature: void __stdcall LuaConstruct_CChangeSpyPriority(void* self_argument, int priority, CCountryTag actor, CCountryTag target)
addresses.comment: **Lua `CChangeSpyPriority(actor, target, priority)`**: news 0x50 bytes and calls the C++ constructor 0x5588F0 with (actor, target, priority) - the actor to +0x3C/+0x40, the target to +0x44/+0x48, the priority to +0x4C, the fields CChangeSpyPriority::Execute reads - then wraps it in a luabind pointer holder (vftable 0x15F229C). luabind's layout puts the int first and the two tags after it. Its one caller, LuabindInvoke_CChangeSpyPriority_Init (0x57FE40), converts Lua argument 1 (stack index 2) to the actor, argument 2 (index 3) to the target and argument 3 (index 4, which must be a number) through lua_tointeger to the priority. `ret 0x18`.
addresses.evidence: Read whole 0x989940-0x989A1A: `push 0x50; call new`, the pushes `[ebp+0xC]` (last), `[ebp+0x1C]`, `[ebp+0x18]`, `[ebp+0x14]`, `[ebp+0x10]`, this, `call 0x5588F0`; 0x5588F0 stores [ebp+0xC]/[ebp+0x10] to +0x3C/+0x40, [ebp+0x14]/[ebp+0x18] to +0x44/+0x48, [ebp+0x1C] to +0x4C, `ret 0x18`. The Lua-index mapping is read in 0x57FE40 (its own entry). Wrong if the luabind invoke's converter order were not the stack order traced there.

addresses.signature: int __cdecl LuabindInvoke_CChangeSpyPriority_Init(void* function@stack:4, void* context@stack:8, lua_State* L@EAX) @EAX
addresses.comment: luabind's overload test and call for `CChangeSpyPriority.__init`. Computes the stack indices 2, 3, 4 for the three arguments after the class table (each converter's arity being 1), requires `lua_gettop == 4`, scores the two tag converters (0x98C7D0 on indices 2 and 3, writing the actor's pointer to [esp+0x1C] and the target's to [esp+0x18]) and `lua_type(4) == LUA_TNUMBER`; when this overload wins alone, reads the two tags by value and `lua_tointeger(L, 4)` - Lua 5.1's conversion, to the nearest - and calls LuaConstruct_CChangeSpyPriority (0x589940). struct_fields.name: countdown
struct_fields.comment: Passes left before slot 10 runs: CAIAgent::Update decrements it and calls slot 10 when it reaches 0. The constructor zeroes it; CAIPoliticsMinister::Enable sets it to 1 + (AI generator % 3), CAIEspionageMinister::Enable to 1 + (AI generator % 10); every minister's slot 10 sets it back to 1, so after the first run it runs every pass.
struct_fields.revises: Adds the intelligence minister's draw, % 10 + 1, beside the politics minister's % 3 + 1.
struct_fields.evidence: CAIEspionageMinister::Enable at 0x89CDA3-0x89CDBA: `call 0xAA2B90` on gamestate+0x124, `mov ecx,0xA; idiv ecx; inc edx; mov [edi+0x30],edx`.

slots_noted: 0x49CDD0 (AIMinister_UnsubscribeAndDisable) is slot 49 of CAIEspionageMinister, CAIForeignMinister and CAIProductionMinister - one body the linker folded across three minister tables (trap 4), so it is named for no one class; its slot is recorded under vftable_slots for all three. CSpyPresence::GetPrimaryMission (0x12D6D0), CSpyPresence::MissionAllowed (0x1305B0) and the CSpyPresence +0x8/+0x50 revisions were read here too and agree with espionage-placing.json, which carries them; they are left out of this file to avoid a collision.
